REPLACEMENT 2026-10-10 (reports/sync-y200-c275.md): JYJE 3TJ424576UYFBC C2149067 (CL 15 pF, 135 in stock) -> YXC X322524576MOB4SI C70568: 24.576 MHz fundamental, CL 12 pF, +/-10 ppm at 25 C, +/-20 ppm -40..85 C, ESR 50 ohm max (16-31 MHz), C0 3 pF max, 3.2 x 2.5 x 0.7 mm, 4055 in stock.
